name: Anhui Deli Household Glass Co., Ltd.
summary: Anhui Deli Household Glass Co., Ltd., based in Chuzhou, China, is a manufacturer and distributor specializing in a diverse range of glassware. Established in 2002, the company supplies products for both the hospitality industry (hotels) and general household use within China, and also engages in international exports. Their extensive product line encompasses various glass items such as goblets, drinking cups, water sets, and wine dispensers. They also produce serving ware like dishes and bowls, sealed storage tanks, as well as distinct series of ashtrays and decanters. Beyond traditional glassware, Anhui Deli additionally offers kitchen supplies and specialized kettle tea makers. The company's offerings are sold via both online platforms and a network of regional sales representatives. These products are marketed under several brands, including Green Apple, AGLAIA, DeLi, Spele, and Idelita.
